newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ono Warehouse to buy majority stake in Royal Elec.
newsitem.headline: Ono Warehouse to buy majority stake in Royal Elec.

text.p: Ono Warehouse Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would make a tender offer to buy shares and convertible bonds issued by Royal Electric Co Ltd which would give Ono a 67.1 percent stake in the firm.
Ono Warehouse, based in Fukui prefecture in central Japan, has offered to buy 2.4 million Royal Electric shares at 2,350 yen per share, an Ono spokesman said.
It will also buy 364 of Royal Electric's Swiss franc-denominated convertible bonds, which can be converted into 738,804 shares.
The friendly take-over bid would be made between September 25 and October 15 this year, a statement by Ono Warehouse said.
Royal Electric also issued a statement saying that the company's board unanimously agreed to the take-over bid on Tuesday.
Tokyo-based Royal Electric, whose shares are traded on the over-the-counter market, manufactures and sells small ventilators.
